title: Removal of the Audio Management Unit and its Mounting Tray from the Flight Compartment Rack
abstract: Removal of the audio management unit and its mounting tray from the flight compartment rack, used for unit exchange, for tray replacement and to get access to the cooling aperture beneath the unit.

sections.purpose: This task removes the audio management unit and, where required, its mounting tray from the flight compartment rack, so that the unit can be exchanged or the cooling path beneath it can be opened.
sections.job_setup_note: The rack must be de-energised and ground power removed before the unit is disturbed. The unit in the upper position sits close to the rear bulkhead and is easy to drag on withdrawal, which damages the rear connector; withdraw it straight and support its weight from below as it clears the tray.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the aircraft is not powered and that ground power is removed. 2. Put the warning notice in the flight compartment. 3. Get access to the rack in zones 211 and 214 by removing the sidewall closeout. 4. Release the unit hold-down and open it fully. 5. Withdraw the unit straight out of the tray and support its weight from below as it clears. CAUTION: DO NOT LET THE UNIT DROP ONTO THE TRAY LIP AS IT CLEARS THE REAR CONNECTOR. THE CONNECTOR SHELL WILL DISTORT AND THE FAULT WILL NOT BE VISIBLE. 6. Fit the protective cap on the rear connector of the unit and put the unit in its transport container. 7. Where the tray is to be removed, remove the retaining screws AES832388-10 and record their positions. 8. Remove the mounting tray D2350116486608 from the rack LU507538-19. 9. Inspect the cooling aperture beneath the tray position and remove any debris. 10. Do a detailed visual inspection of the rack lower guide and report any distortion. 11. Check that the display unit GRA872629-19 in the same column is undisturbed and still locked. WARNING: DO NOT RESTORE AIRCRAFT POWER WITH AN OPEN RACK POSITION AND NO BLANKING PLATE. THE COOLING FLOW WILL BE DIVERTED FROM THE ADJACENT UNITS.
sections.close_out: Fit a blanking plate in the open rack position if power is to be restored. Leave the sidewall closeout off if the tray is to be replaced in the same visit. Make an entry in the technical log that the audio integrating system is inoperative.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The perforated tray applies post MOD-152735.

safety_precautions: Remove ground power before the unit is disturbed.
Do not restore power with an open rack position and no blanking plate.
Support the unit weight as it clears the tray.
